(Ref: https://github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect/pull/23893)

workarounds.symptom: Windows: cancelling a run served by flow.serve() later stops the serve process and interrupts the script that started it
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Stop served flow runs on Windows without a console-wide CTRL_BREAK. Target files: src/prefect/runner/_process_manager.py, src/prefect/runner/_starter_bundle.py, src/prefect/runner/_starter_direct.py. Flow runs started by `flow.serve()` (and bundle executions) run in a `multiprocessing` spawn child. On Windows, the forced kill sent `CTRL_BREAK_EVENT` to that child's pid. Console control events can only target a process group, and the spawn child is not a group leader. The event did not stop the child. It reached every proc... (Ref: https://github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect/pull/23895)

An App made by `pi-dispatch setup github` does not have that permission, so the read answered 403. The worker retried that as an infrastructure error, and every forge job failed with `worker-error`. (Ref: https://github.com/edgehero/pi-dispatch/pull/883)

If the budget-reset job fails partway through, the next run will reset end-users on rollover budgets again, causing customers to lose the spend they should have carried into the new window. Now each end-user, customer team and customer member records the window of its last reset, and a retry skips anyone already ... (Ref: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/pull/51143)

workarounds.symptom: update: a version npm announces but does not serve yet fails the update
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(update): defer a latest release that npm does not serve yet. Target files: implementations/cli/smoke/command-kernel.smoke.ts, implementations/cli/src/commands/update.ts, packages/workspace/src/updates.ts. In the minutes after a release, npm names the new version as latest before every registry read serves it. `cotal update --self` then picked the version, `npm install` answered `ETARGET`, and the update was reported as failed and rolled back. On the automatic path the same thing could count toward pausing that version. (Ref: https://github.com/Cotal-AI/Cotal/pull/6780)
